$comment-1: QuantConnect LEAN project config for v1_trend_following — Day 4 09:00.
$comment-2: Two deploy paths are supported by this file:
$comment-3: (a) QC Cloud (the Day 4 10:00 path): operator uploads the algorithm via the QC dashboard. Cloud reads `algorithm-language`, `algorithm-type-name`, and `parameters`; the brokerage is chosen at deploy time in the Live Trading deploy form (recommended: 'Quant Connect Paper Trading' until IBKR Pro is approved).
$comment-4: (b) LEAN Local CLI (`lean live --environment live-paper-qc`): used Phase 2+ for offline parity testing. Reads `environments`. Not run on Day 4 — left ready for later.
$comment-5: Phase 1 architecture (CLAUDE.md): backend has NO direct IBKR connection. The QC algorithm is the only thing that talks to a broker. Signals + broker state cross to the backend via QC ObjectStore only.
description: v1_trend_following — Donchian/MA/Hurst/ATR trend strategy on Phase 1 sub-universe (CME micro futures + bond ETFs). Daily resolution, 17:30 ET signal cycle. Phase 0–1 paper trading on QC.
$comment-parameters: Mirrors strategies/v1_trend_following/parameters.py V1_DEFAULTS. QC's UI exposes these as overridable knobs in the Live deploy form; the algorithm reads them via self.GetParameter(...) with the V1_DEFAULTS as fallback. Keys are the canonical agent `tighten_parameter` enum names (backend-spec §12.3) — never rename without a parameter_sets migration.

environments.$comment: LEAN Local CLI environments. Cloud deploys ignore this map; cloud reads only the top-level `algorithm-*` fields plus `parameters`.

live-paper-qc.$comment-broker: QC's built-in paper broker. No real money; no IBKR dependency. This is the correct env name to pass to `lean live --environment live-paper-qc` for offline parity testing.

live-paper-ibkr.$comment-broker: Reserved for Phase 2 once IBKR Pro is approved + IB Gateway runs locally. Do not use until then. ib-async/IBGateway dependencies are not installed in the Phase 0 LEAN Local container.

backtesting.$comment: Default for QC Cloud backtests. No special config needed; LEAN engine fills defaults.
